referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for an appartment building with a specific air flow rate of 0.92 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on a study of an appartment building with 6 flats, a heated gross floor area of 780 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 720 m3/h. The inventory includes an average of decentral and central systems. It includes average components for air handling units, ducts (including 30mm thermal insulation where needed), air valves, roof-hoods, dampers and silencers. No insuation for fire protection or fire dampers included. The data represents horizontal ductwork mainly made of polyethylene and vertical ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel. It includes compact air handling units with cross plate heat excangers as heat recovery and a nominal air flow rate of 200-1200 m3/h per unit. No ground heat exchanger, ventilation of side rooms, cellars or car parks are included.; UUID: 10929b10-32e2-3c73-85db-da6c8b26d307
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Materials used for the production. Energy use for the different production steps and for heating the production building. Transport of raw materials to the plant. Estimation for infrastructure of the production site included.
